name: Inventory Management
description: Simulates a warehouse inventory system with stock level tracking, order fulfillment with stock reservation (contention on popular items), supplier restocking, and real-time inventory dashboards. Tests serializable transactions for stock consistency under concurrent order processing.

setup_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS warehouses (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name STRING NOT NULL, location STRING NOT NULL, capacity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10000, INDEX idx_wh_location (location))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory_items (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), sku STRING NOT NULL UNIQUE, name STRING NOT NULL, category STRING NOT NULL, unit_price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, warehouse_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses(id), quantity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reserved INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reorder_level INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), INDEX idx_inv_sku (sku), INDEX idx_inv_warehouse (warehouse_id), INDEX idx_inv_category (category), INDEX idx_inv_low_stock (quantity, reorder_level))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory_orders (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), order_type STRING NOT NULL, status STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', total DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, INDEX idx_ord_status (status), INDEX idx_ord_created (created_at DESC))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS order_lines (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_orders(id), item_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_items(id), quantity INT NOT NULL, unit_price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, INDEX idx_lines_order (order_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_movements (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), item_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_items(id), movement_type STRING NOT NULL, quantity INT NOT NULL, reference_id UUID, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), INDEX idx_movements_item (item_id, created_at DESC))
seed_sql: INSERT INTO warehouses (id, name, location) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'Warehouse ' || generate_series::STRING, CASE (generate_series % 3) WHEN 0 THEN 'us-east' WHEN 1 THEN 'us-west' ELSE 'eu-west' END FROM generate_series(1, 5)

INSERT INTO inventory_items (id, sku, name, category, unit_price, warehouse_id, quantity, reorder_level) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'SKU-' || LPAD(generate_series::STRING, 5, '0'), 'Item ' || generate_series::STRING, CASE (generate_series % 5) WHEN 0 THEN 'electronics' WHEN 1 THEN 'clothing' WHEN 2 THEN 'food' WHEN 3 THEN 'tools' ELSE 'supplies' END, (5 + random() * 495)::DECIMAL(10,2), (SELECT id FROM warehouses ORDER BY random() LIMIT 1), 50 + (random() * 450)::INT, 10 + (random() * 40)::INT FROM generate_series(1, 500)

operations.name: fulfill_order
sql: UPDATE inventory_items SET quantity = quantity - $1, reserved = reserved + $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2 AND quantity >= $1
INSERT INTO inventory_orders (order_type, status, total) VALUES ('fulfillment', 'processing', $3)
INSERT INTO order_lines (order_id, item_id, quantity, unit_price) VALUES (currval('inventory_orders_id_seq'), $2, $1, $4)
INSERT INTO stock_movements (item_id, movement_type, quantity) VALUES ($2, 'reserved', -$1)

operations.name: check_stock
sql: SELECT i.sku, i.name, i.quantity, i.reserved, (i.quantity - i.reserved) as available, i.unit_price, w.name as warehouse FROM inventory_items i JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id WHERE i.id = $1

operations.name: restock
sql: UPDATE inventory_items SET quantity = quantity + $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2
INSERT INTO stock_movements (item_id, movement_type, quantity) VALUES ($2, 'restock', $1)

operations.name: low_stock_alert
sql: SELECT i.sku, i.name, i.category, i.quantity, i.reorder_level, w.name as warehouse, w.location FROM inventory_items i JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id WHERE i.quantity <= i.reorder_level ORDER BY (i.quantity::FLOAT / GREATEST(i.reorder_level, 1)) ASC LIMIT 50

operations.name: inventory_dashboard
sql: SELECT w.name, w.location, COUNT(i.id) as item_count, SUM(i.quantity) as total_stock, SUM(i.reserved) as total_reserved, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) as total_value FROM warehouses w JOIN inventory_items i ON i.warehouse_id = w.id GROUP BY w.id, w.name, w.location ORDER BY total_value DESC

operations.name: stock_history
sql: SELECT sm.movement_type, sm.quantity, sm.created_at, i.sku, i.name FROM stock_movements sm JOIN inventory_items i ON i.id = sm.item_id WHERE sm.item_id = $1 ORDER BY sm.created_at DESC LIMIT 20
